value.rationale: The previously established cyclic string-attractor invariant has lacked a Thue--Morse family classification in the examined results. An all-order four-position optimum with a reusable block-seam transport lemma and a sharp 40-versus-39 factor-count obstruction is structurally motivated, not an arbitrary isolated computation. The first two higher-scale exact eighty-extremizer censuses exhibit five distinct boundary families versus two in the known linear case, giving useful natural finite structural data while explicitly withholding an unproved infinite count.
